feeds.title: My Jewish Learning Blog
feeds.description: My Jewish Learning is all about empowering Jewish discovery for anyone interested in learning more. They offer thousands of articles, videos, and other resources to help you navigate all aspects of Judaism and Jewish life. Their mission is to educate others on all things Jewish.

feeds.title: Jewish LearningWorks Blog
feeds.description: They are a 501c3 and our mission is to elevate the field of Jewish education by nurturing educators, inspiring innovation, and building Jewish literacy.

feeds.title: Jewish Education Innovation Challenge
feeds.description: JEIC is a bold initiative to radically improve the quality of Jewish education in day schools across North America. We bring together educators, funders, influencers and consumers to pursue lasting school culture change through innovation, experimentation, and collaboration. Initiated in 2012 by the Mayberg Foundation and supported through multiple philanthropic partnerships, JEIC seeks to ignite students' passion for Jewish learning by improving the way Jewish values, literacy, practice, and beliefs are transferred to the next generation.

feeds.title: JewishGen Blog » Education
feeds.description: Explore millions of records from around the world, identify relatives, discover the towns of your ancestors, experience how they lived, connect with our global JewishGen community, and more!

feeds.title: Hillel Torah Blog
feeds.description: Find the latest happenings and knowledge from Hillel Torah Blog. Welcome to Hillel Torah. We are a dynamic, Modern Orthodox day school preparing the Jewish leaders of tomorrow. Rooted in Torah learning and values, we encourage children to develop a life-long commitment to Medinat Yisrael, the Jewish people, and the global community.

feeds.title: JET Ottawa Blog
feeds.description: Read stories including topics; The Self Made Man, Free Falling, How to Achieve World Peace, and more. JET Ottawa is a dynamic outreach organization dedicated to providing engaging classes and inspiring Jewish experiences. JET's mission, to show that added Jewish knowledge and practice bring meaning and value to our lives, has gradually, over time, made a substantive difference in the fabric of the Ottawa Jewish community.

feeds.title: Saul Mirowitz Jewish Community School Blog
feeds.description: Mirowitz Jewish Community School is located in St. Louis, Missouri, USA. Mirowitz is a private, Jewish day school providing education from early childhood through middle school. The school blog contains information about the school's mission, curriculum, faculty, admissions process, and extracurricular activities. It may also include resources for current students and parents, as well as news and events related to the school community.

feeds.title: Torah Academy News
feeds.description: The Torah Academy news blog features updates on school events, achievements, and educational programs. It highlights student projects, such as STEM initiatives and Chumash celebrations, and offers reflections on community and educational practices. The blog also covers special events like teacher conferences and partnerships aimed at enhancing student well-being, providing a comprehensive view of the vibrant and dynamic life at Torah Academy.

feeds.title: The Unpacked for Educators Blog
feeds.description: The Unpacked for Educators blog shares tips and insights on modern Jewish education, covering topics such as teaching strategies, classroom resources, cultural learning, and educational perspectives. It features categories like education insights, product updates, and practical teaching methods. Posts help educators explain Jewish history, Israel, identity, and current events in engaging and meaningful ways, including pieces like using Israeli music to help students understand the mood in Israel after Oct. 7.

feeds.title: Jewish Educational Services Blog
feeds.description: The JES Baltimore News and Blog section shares updates on Jewish education in the Baltimore community, including stories about teacher support, school programs, family resources, and initiatives that strengthen Jewish learning and identity. It highlights educational events, classroom insights, and community efforts that help schools and educators provide meaningful and inclusive learning experiences.

feeds.title: PAJES Blog
feeds.description: The PaJeS blog shares articles on Jewish education in the UK, focusing on school leadership, inclusion, curriculum updates, community issues, and ways to improve student wellbeing. It features insights from educators and discusses challenges and developments affecting Jewish schools.

feeds.title: Jim Joseph Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Jim Joseph Foundation's News and Blogs section shares updates and insights on Jewish education, youth engagement, leadership development, and community programs supported by the foundation. It highlights learning initiatives, grant impacts, and stories from partner organizations that strengthen Jewish identity and meaningful learning experiences.

feeds.title: Makom Community Blog
feeds.description: Read Makom Community's Blog for news about what we are learning in afterschool enrichment and School's Out Camp, community announcements, events and more!

feeds.title: Jewish Federation of Greater Atlanta Blog
feeds.description: The Jewish Atlanta blog shares stories about community life, education, inclusion, philanthropy, and cultural events in the Atlanta Jewish community. It highlights how local programs and support efforts create meaningful impact for Jewish individuals and families both locally and globally.

feeds.title: Jewish Montessori Musings Blog
feeds.description: The Shaarei Chinuch Day School blog Jewish Montessori Musings shares insights on Montessori education, focusing on child‑driven learning, independence, responsibility, and building a community based on Jewish values. It highlights classroom practices that nurture each child's unique strengths.

feeds.title: JNTP Blog
feeds.description: The Jewish New Teacher Project (JNTP) blog shares news and reflections on how the project supports Jewish day‑school teachers and administrators. It highlights efforts to mentor new educators, improve teaching practices, support school leaders, and strengthen overall school culture across Jewish day schools. The blog shows how JNTP's mentoring and coaching initiatives help educators succeed early in their careers and positively impact student learning and school quality.

feeds.title: Jewish Learning Venture Blog
feeds.description: The Jewish Learning Venture blog shares stories and insights on inclusive Jewish education, family engagement, and community programs. It highlights accessible teaching practices and ways to strengthen Jewish learning and identity for children and families.

feeds.title: The Jewish Federation of Sarasota-Manatee Blog
feeds.description: The Jewish Federation of Sarasota-Manatee blog shares posts about Jewish education, community events, Israel programs, and initiatives that strengthen Jewish identity. It highlights programs for youth and adults, community engagement, and efforts to support learning and meaningful connections within the Jewish community.

feeds.title: Rabbi Jon's Blog » Jewish Education
feeds.description: I'm Jon Spira-Savett, rabbi at Temple Beth Abraham in Nashua, New Hampshire. This website and blog is a resource for Jewish learning and Jewish action. It is a way to share my thoughts beyond my classes and weekly Divrei Torah. You'll find blog posts, standing resource pages with links and things to read.

feeds.title: Texas Jewish Post » Education
feeds.description: The Texas Jewish Post Education section reports on how schools, curriculum, and educational policies affect Jewish students and communities. It covers issues in local schools, including religious content and events impacting Jewish education.

feeds.title: Bialk Blog
feeds.description: The Bialik Hebrew Day School blog shares articles on school life, community news, events, parenting, leadership, and Jewish values.

feeds.title: Yaffed Blog
feeds.description: YAFFED (Young Advocates for Fair Education) runs a blog sharing news, reports, and updates about secular‑education advocacy and reforms for Hasidic and Haredi schools in New York.

feeds.title: HBHA Blog
feeds.description: Hyman Brand Hebrew Academy (HBHA) was founded in 1966 by a group of parents who felt strongly about having a Jewish day school education for their children. Their goal was to provide an exceptional foundation in both general and Jewish academics to the children of Kansas City. The school, then named Hebrew Academy, opened its doors with 33 students, with Hyman Brand, z'l, serving as the first president.

feeds.title: Chinuch Perspectives
feeds.description: This Chinuch Perspectives blog discusses various perspectives on education, particularly in the context of Jewish education. It covers topics such as teaching methodologies, educational philosophy, curriculum development, and discussions on issues relevant to educators within the Jewish community.

feeds.title: The Lookstein Center Blog
feeds.description: The Lookstein Center is dedicated to providing critical supports for Jewish educators as they learn, teach, and lead in the twenty-first century to ensure an engaged and educated Jewish community.
